summary: Milestone M1 of build tier2-webhook verifies ready-with-findings. All five steps are documented and none is blocked; the plan gate is approved and M1 has no predecessor. All 46 in-scope cross-step references resolve - the 12 permission-set field grants against M1-S01's fields (Status__c correctly excluded as required), the principal grant against the External Credential's file stem and parameterName, all 18 Apex custom symbols, the five event payload fields against the event definition, the seven restricted picklist literals against their value sets, and callout:OnCall_Tool against the Named Credential. Four further references resolve only against the target org and are documented external prerequisites. The merged manifest (7 types, 33 members, version 67.0, no conflict) is member-for-member identical to artefacts/M1-S05/package.xml - no drift. All three declared checker acceptance tests ran verbatim and exited 0; the milestone's manual test joins five step manual tests in a six-line human checklist. Deployment order is consistent in the artefacts, with one backwards dependency remaining in plan.json's own stale M1-S05 step input. Five new findings (one P1: no Apex test has ever executed) and eight previously-recorded decision items are put to the human. The gate was not approved and nothing was deployed.
confidence_rationale: AGENT.md Step 10 MEDIUM: four references are unclassifiable - the Tier_2_Engineering queue by DeveloperName, the org-wide sender, PermissionSetAssignment read, and the ApiKey half of the $Credential formula - each resolving against the target org rather than any artefact of this or an earlier milestone. Not LOW: every declared checker exists and ran, no artefact directory is empty, no step is blocked, and there is no earlier milestone inventory to fail.

dimensions_skipped.reason: AGENT.md Step 4 reads the position the doc keeper recorded on the artefact's workbook row. At scale: feature the workbook is optional and this build skipped it build-wide, so no workbook row exists. Position of record was taken from each step's deploy-order.md and the compiled table in artefacts/M1-S05/deploy-order.md section 2 instead - sufficient to check every dependency, but not the artefact-by-artefact recorded-position cross-check the step describes.

findings.title: No Apex test has ever executed; coverage is unmeasured
findings.detail: The milestone ships 13 ApexClass and 2 ApexTrigger. Mock-deploy run 5 records runTestsEnabled false, numberTestsCompleted 0 and testLevel null, so the five test classes were written and read but never run. Per skills/devops/pre-deployment-checklist a production deploy requires RunLocalTests with 75 percent org-wide coverage; the predicted failure per skills/devops/deployment-error-diagnosis is 'Average test coverage across all Apex Classes is below 75%'. A sandbox deploy at NoTestRun passes and reports nothing. No checker in the library can produce this signal.
findings.recommendation: Run sf project deploy validate --test-level RunLocalTests against the production target and capture the coverage number before the deploy.

findings.title: PermissionSet full-replace was never checked against the target org
findings.detail: From API v40+ a PermissionSet deploy fully replaces the target record and silently removes anything not in the XML (skills/devops/permission-set-deployment-ordering, Full-Replace Semantics). Tier2_Webhook_Admin is new in this build, but no step confirmed the target holds no set of that name, and the pre-deployment-checklist pre-release-backup gate was never run.
findings.recommendation: Retrieve PermissionSet:Tier2_Webhook_Admin from the target before deploying; an empty result clears it.

findings.title: The feature cannot be deployed dark: both triggers arrive Active and there is no kill switch
findings.detail: CaseTrigger.trigger-meta.xml and IntegrationFailureTrigger.trigger-meta.xml both declare status Active, and remedy B removed TriggerControl. Escalation is live the instant the deploy lands - before manual step 2 enters the API key and before manual step 3 assigns Tier2_Webhook_Admin - so every Case escalated in that window returns 401 and lands an Integration_Failure__c row.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CaseTrigger with status Inactive and activate after manual steps 2 and 3, or deploy off-hours and complete both immediately.

findings.title: Milestone acceptance test 3's description undercounts its own findings
findings.detail: The declared description says 'exit 0 with exactly those two WARN findings'. The run over artefacts produces four - ExternalCredential and NamedCredential once each for M1-S02/package.xml and M1-S05/package.xml. The fixture it was verified on predated the M1-S05 manifest. Exit code 0 either way; the test passes. Prose only.
findings.recommendation: Prose-only amendment on the milestone test description if a writer for it exists.

findings.title: Finding-id namespace collision between the scenario sequence and a step-local one
findings.detail: S2-F-01..05 are scenario-level ids minted by the operator's mock-deploy runs (S2 = scenario 2 in reports/drivers-log.md). S3-F-01..07 are step-local ids minted by the M1-S03 runner (S3 = step M1-S03). Read as a scenario prefix, S3 looks like a scenario that does not exist in this build. This report continues the scenario sequence at S2-F-06 and renumbers nothing.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a step-scoped form that cannot be misread, e.g. M1-S03-F-01.

manual_checklist: M1-S01 - Open Status__c.field-meta.xml and Severity__c.field-meta.xml and confirm both value sets are restricted and hold exactly New/Retrying/Resent/Resolved/Abandoned and exactly Error/Warning, character for character with the Apex constants.

M1-S02 - From artefacts/M1-S02 alone confirm: (a) externalCredentialPrincipal reads exactly OnCall_Tool_EC-OnCallToolNamedPrincipal; (b) no credential value appears in any of the three files; (c) generateAuthorizationHeader is explicitly false; (d) fieldPermissions carries Case.Tier2_Notified_At__c readable and editable plus every Integration_Failure__c field bar Status__c; (e) a named person accepts the D14 assignee set or sends D14 back; (f) the X-API-Key formula is flagged for confirmation before deploy.

M1-S03 - Open Tier2EscalationService.cls and Tier2WebhookQueueable.cls and confirm (a) EventBus.publish is in the service, in the escalating transaction, with its List<Database.SaveResult> inspected and a failure writing an Integration_Failure__c row; (b) no class sets an X-API-Key or Authorization header, reads a credential value or names a literal hostname, and every endpoint is callout:OnCall_Tool.

M1-S04 - Confirm (a) the CRON literal is hourly and the Schedulable's execute() does nothing but enqueue; (b) the two thresholds are Q24's - more than three failures in an hour, or no success in 24 hours while escalations exist; (c) the sender is support-noreply@acme.example and a named person confirms that org-wide address is already verified in the target org.

M1-S05 - Confirm deploy-order.md section 3 lists the five manual steps no deploy performs, each with an owner and a timing, and that the mock_deploy.py command is written as text for a human rather than as anything an agent executes.

M1 (milestone) - Open artefacts/M1-S05/deploy-order.md alongside the five steps' artefacts and confirm (a) the deploy order runs ExternalCredential, NamedCredential, PermissionSet, object and field metadata, then Apex AS THE NOTE'S SECTION 2 TABLE STATES IT, not as the plan's stale step input states it (see report section 4); (b) the build-level package.xml names every ApexClass and ApexTrigger from M1-S03 and M1-S04 and every member from M1-S01 and M1-S02, with no member lacking a file and no file lacking a member; (c) the note states the two steps no deploy performs - a human entering the API key against the OnCall_Tool_EC principal, and assigning Tier2_Webhook_Admin to the D14 assignee set.
